person.persName: عبد الرحمن بن أحمد بن علي القبايلي المغربي
عبد الرحمن بن أحمد بن علي

death.note: He was executed (slaughtered) in Shawwal 803 AH.

relation.note: Abū al-ʿAbbās Aḥmad b. ʿAlī al-Qabāyilī (AIND-D01104), vizier of the ruler of the Maghrib, whose entry explicitly states that he and his son ʿAbd al-Raḥmān were imprisoned and slaughtered in Shawwāl [80]3.

event.desc: He was executed (slaughtered) in Shawwal 803 AH.

person.note: アブド・アッラフマーン・ビン・アフマド・ビン・アリー・アル＝カバーイリー・アル＝マグリビー。彼の父については前に述べた。彼は（その父親の伝記で）言及されているように、803年シャウワール月に惨殺（処刑）された。
ʿAbd al-Raḥmān b. Aḥmad b. ʿAlī al-Qabāʾilī al-Maghribī. His father was mentioned previously. He was executed (slaughtered) in Shawwāl of the year 803 AH, as mentioned there (in his father's entry).
